framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition details within 4 trading days of crossing the threshold; triggers open-offer if 25% or 40.5% threshold breached.

headline: Tech Mahindra: M&M Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Mahindra and Mahindra filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's SAST Regulations 2011 with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition or shareholding milestone in Tech Mahindra. The filing signals compliance with open-offer or disclosure thresholds under India's takeover code.
detail: Mahindra and Mahindra Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, concerning Tech Mahindra. This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses thresholds that trigger mandatory open-offer requirements. The exact shareholding percentage crossed, consideration, and timing of the acquisition remain to be disclosed in the full Regulation 31(4) statement.
